minutes_text:
INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES –June 22, 2022

The Inglewood Library Board met on June 22, 2022 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 4: 32 p.m. by
Board Member Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Absent Staff:
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for May 25, 2022.
  Board Member Castillo seconded the motion.

  All the Board Members approved the minutes.

Board discussion items

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh introduced Gary Vilinsky who is the furniture consultant for the
Morningside Park Branch Library.

  1
   Gary Vilinsky shared his screen with all meeting participants and introduced proposed furniture,
manufacturer’s warranties and the location where they will be placed.
  Lead architect Gwynne Pugh talked about colors, fabrics and materials of proposed furniture.
  Document: Morningside Library Furniture

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh told Board Members that Library Manager Kerri Arroyo is on
vacation this week and there is no library update. Everything that was part of Library update would be in weekly
newsletter.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) reminded everyone about
having a book sale on July 15 from 11a.m. – 2 p.m. for friends and family and on July 16 from 10 a.m. – 2 p.m.
regular book sale in the depository of the Main Library.

Public Comments

  Community member Aldridge made a comment on the lack of diversity in regards to the hiring of the
architect.

Commissioner Comments

  Board members Douglas and Castillo thanked everyone for the update.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:07 p.m.
